status: Future acceptance declarations only; no runtime implementation or passing test evidence

cases.name: Another account cannot preview or confirm erasure
cases.given: Accounts A and B exist with distinct root keys and records
cases.when: A signs a preview or confirmation selecting B or substitutes B into A's valid request
cases.then: Reject without disclosing B's inventory or changing either account
cases.evidence_required: Real API proof-binding and two-owner database assertions

cases.name: Bearer, ordinary device and controller do not possess erasure authority
cases.given: Valid bearer and scoped device credentials exist
cases.when: Each attempts root-only preview or confirmation, including a controller with every defined management scope
cases.then: Reject; no sessions, records or account state change
cases.evidence_required: Authorization matrix over actual root/device/session routes

cases.name: Login or rotation proof cannot authorize erasure
cases.given: Valid v1 login and v2 rotation or preview proofs exist
cases.when: They are supplied as erasure_confirm or their purpose is changed
cases.then: Reject domain/purpose mismatch even if signer and account match
cases.evidence_required: Cross-client transcript vectors and API negative signatures

cases.name: Expired, reused or stale-root confirmation cannot execute
cases.given: A valid confirmation challenge and root are known
cases.when: Server-time expiry passes, challenge is replayed, or root rotates before confirmation
cases.then: Reject and require a fresh authorized preview/proof as appropriate; never close using historical authority
cases.evidence_required: Controlled server clock, challenge reuse and real concurrent rotation tests

cases.name: Preview data and acknowledgement cannot be substituted
cases.given: An owner reviewed one canonical preview
cases.when: Scope, account, policy hash, receipt digest, revision, operation ID or acknowledgement is changed after signing
cases.then: Reject signature/hash/schema mismatch without partial closure
cases.evidence_required: Field-by-field mutation corpus on all client proof implementations and API

cases.name: Ambiguous JSON and unsafe counters fail before authorization
cases.given: Erasure request parser receives duplicate or unknown fields, noncanonical UUID/base64url or overflowing/numeric counters
cases.when: Request is decoded
cases.then: Return bounded invalid-request error; do not canonicalize away ambiguity or perform work
cases.evidence_required: Raw HTTP parser cases and shared boundary fixtures

cases.name: Missing inventory or retention acceptance fails closed
cases.given: One enabled domain has unknown inventory or policy lacks an accepted backup/retention value
cases.when: Owner requests confirmation
cases.then: Reject with reviewable blocked disposition; no invented zero count, date or indefinite audit exception
cases.evidence_required: Policy-validator and actual preview/confirmation assertions

cases.name: Expired or superseded preview cannot confirm
cases.given: An old preview exists and a newer preview is issued or time expires
cases.when: Owner signs the old preview with a fresh challenge
cases.then: Old preview still fails; active account remains unchanged
cases.evidence_required: API state test with server clock and two previews

cases.name: Finance write wins before confirmation
cases.given: Preview is current and a finance transaction obtains the shared account fence first
cases.when: Write commits and confirmation then obtains its exclusive fence
cases.then: The write remains balanced and confirmation conflicts on changed revision; no silent expanded deletion scope
cases.evidence_required: Two independent PostgreSQL connections with controlled lock ordering

cases.name: Confirmation wins before finance write
cases.given: Preview is current and confirmation obtains the exclusive fence first
cases.when: Old-session wallet or journal write proceeds after closure commits
cases.then: Write is denied inside its transaction; no domain or idempotency row is inserted
cases.evidence_required: Two-connection API/database race, including legacy routes

cases.name: Session issuance and legacy access cannot bypass closure
cases.given: An old v1/v2 session and unused auth challenge predate closure
cases.when: They are used after closure; a fresh challenge/sign-in is also attempted
cases.then: No new usable session, profile, finance, cache or download access is granted
cases.evidence_required: All implemented route matrix plus issuance/closure race

cases.name: Profile, enrollment, policy and domain changes invalidate preview
cases.given: Owner has a prepared preview
cases.when: Profile edit, device enrollment, hold/policy change, new job or ownership change commits before confirmation
cases.then: Expected inventory/security/policy revisions no longer match; require a new preview and proof
cases.evidence_required: Actual database interleavings for each enabled change producer

cases.name: Closure commit and dependent work are atomic
cases.given: Valid root proof and independently durable suppression intent
cases.when: Failure is injected after each SQL mutation in the closure transaction
cases.then: Account/domain state is wholly active or closed with durable work and receipt; no closed account without resumable tasks and no partial journal changes
cases.evidence_required: PostgreSQL failure injection and reconciliation of any unresolved external intent

cases.name: Registry outage before intent prevents confirmation
cases.given: Independent suppression registry is unreachable before intent acknowledgement
cases.when: Owner confirms
cases.then: Do not commit account closure or claim acceptance; bounded unavailable/unknown result preserves retry identity
cases.evidence_required: Network fault at durable intent boundary and database assertions

cases.name: Crash between external intent and database commit remains conservative
cases.given: Valid suppression intent is durable independently
cases.when: Process or database fails before the closure outcome is established
cases.then: Unresolved intent survives disaster recovery; restored account stays quarantined until durable commit/abort evidence resolves it
cases.evidence_required: Independent-store crash injection and pre-confirmation snapshot restore

cases.name: Lost confirmation reply does not execute a second erasure
cases.given: Closure committed but HTTP response was dropped
cases.when: Client queries status using saved receipt credential and retries the same operation correctly
cases.then: One closure epoch, one work graph and the same operation receipt exist; no fresh account session is issued
cases.evidence_required: Dropped-response API test with operation/epoch/task counts

cases.name: Changed payload under same operation is rejected
cases.given: A preview or committed closure exists for an operation UUID
cases.when: Client reuses UUID with changed preview, receipt hash or scope
cases.then: Return conflict; retain original immutable result
cases.evidence_required: Durable API idempotency assertions after process restart

cases.name: Timeout does not imply rollback or cancellation
cases.given: Confirmation is still in flight and status is queried before its commit
cases.when: Client sees not-found or times out
cases.then: UI preserves unknown outcome and same operation; it does not report cancellation, generate new deletion identity or auto-submit on reconnect
cases.evidence_required: Deterministic web/Android/iOS transport ordering tests

cases.name: Stale cache fill cannot recreate live owner totals
cases.given: A summary request read finance before closure and pauses before cache publication
cases.when: Closure and owner cache purge complete, then stale publisher resumes
cases.then: Fence blocks late refill or purge reconciliation removes it before active-store completion; post-closure requests never serve cached totals
cases.evidence_required: Actual PostgreSQL/Valkey race including old revision keys

cases.name: Ordinary runtime cannot use the purge exception
cases.given: Normal runtime role can read/write its permitted owner data
cases.when: It attempts DELETE, trigger bypass, forged erasure session setting, arbitrary owner or direct purge function execution
cases.then: RLS/grants/immutability reject it; no other owner or active owner is affected
cases.evidence_required: SQL negative matrix with non-owner role and pooled-context reuse

cases.name: Purge erases the whole current personal graph
cases.given: Closed A has profile, wallets, journals, postings, idempotency snapshots, auth rows and caches; B remains active
cases.when: Eligible A purge completes
cases.then: Privileged reconciliation finds none of A's in-scope online copies, including embedded idempotency financial JSON; B's exact balances and access remain intact
cases.evidence_required: Real two-owner DB/cache inventory checks, not only HTTP denial

cases.name: Worker crashes and duplicate deliveries are resumable
cases.given: A sealed owner manifest and multiple deletion batches exist
cases.when: Worker crashes after each checkpoint or receives duplicate tasks
cases.then: Already absent records succeed idempotently, no cross-owner deletion occurs, closure persists and completion waits for reconciliation
cases.evidence_required: Fault-injected worker/database integration and lease expiry tests

cases.name: Retention exception is explicit and expires
cases.given: Approved category-specific retention/hold covers a subset of records
cases.when: Owner confirms and eligible data is purged, then retained category expires
cases.then: Receipt states retained reason/deadline and access restrictions; no full-erasure claim until the retention domain and its copies are resolved
cases.evidence_required: Policy, restricted-role, scheduled expiry and receipt assertions

cases.name: Shared data cannot be erased using personal authority
cases.given: Future shared ledger contains A and B contributions or A is the last household owner
cases.when: A requests personal account erasure
cases.then: Preview identifies shared disposition and required ownership decision; no automatic deletion of B's ledger or silent owner transfer
cases.evidence_required: Future two-household/shared-ownership suite before sharing enablement

cases.name: Leased and delayed jobs cannot recreate or deliver account data
cases.given: Future import/OCR/export/recurring jobs are queued, leased, retried and dead-lettered
cases.when: Account closes before execution, commit or delivery
cases.then: All producer boundaries reject stale ownership; payload/result copies are purged and no money or downloadable result is delivered
cases.evidence_required: Future actual queue/outbox race at every boundary

cases.name: Late provider callback cannot re-create mapping
cases.given: Provider request was dispatched before closure and mapping later purged
cases.when: A retry, webhook or provider response arrives
cases.then: Suppression/fence prevents auto-recreation/import; unresolved external processing stays visible until acknowledged or disclosed limited
cases.evidence_required: Future provider sandbox callback/retry and mapping assertions

cases.name: Provider disconnect and timeout are not deletion evidence
cases.given: Future provider has tokens and processing copies
cases.when: Disconnect succeeds but deletion times out or provider cannot erase an independent copy
cases.then: Palmy tokens/mappings purge; receipt remains pending/limited or blocked for external data, never confirmed merely from disconnect
cases.evidence_required: Provider adapter contract tests and reviewed external evidence

cases.name: Files, versions and signed links stay in scope
cases.given: Future originals, thumbnails, OCR text, multipart uploads, quarantined objects, versions and signed downloads exist
cases.when: Owner erasure runs
cases.then: Every version/derivative is reconciled; raw preissued URL limitation is stated until actual revocation/expiry; delete-marker alone does not prove bytes removed
cases.evidence_required: Future object-store integration and preissued URL test

cases.name: Pre-erasure backup cannot resurrect owner
cases.given: Encrypted backup predates closure but independent registry contains its confirmed suppression
cases.when: Restore occurs into quarantine
cases.then: Purge/suppress A and restored auth/jobs/caches before any API, worker or export; B remains usable and invariant checks pass
cases.evidence_required: Real fresh-cluster restore using an older snapshot and separate registry

cases.name: Missing or stale restore registry blocks exposure
cases.given: Restored database appears healthy
cases.when: Registry is unavailable, stale, tampered, missing sequence or cannot resolve an intent
cases.then: Traffic/workers/export/backup propagation remain disabled; health alone never certifies erasure-safe restore
cases.evidence_required: Disaster-recovery fault tests with explicit exposure gate assertions

cases.name: Backup horizon uses all actual copies
cases.given: A backup/WAL/replica or restored copy containing A was created after closure during delayed purge
cases.when: Old planned deadline arrives
cases.then: Do not claim complete; include later copy and any retained category in the evidenced horizon and escalate overdue expiry
cases.evidence_required: Backup inventory clock scenarios and copy reconciliation

cases.name: Retirement marker cannot be treated as anonymous or silently purged
cases.given: Account rows and receipts are purged but a restore/late-producer window remains
cases.when: Marker retention expires in a misconfiguration or the same account UUID is registered
cases.then: Reject unsafe configuration/reuse; retain only accepted minimal marker or keep activation blocked until an approved retirement alternative exists
cases.evidence_required: Retention validator, registration and restore suppression tests

cases.name: Receipt capability exposes only its own bounded status
cases.given: Operation A has a saved receipt credential and B has another operation
cases.when: A credential selects B, a bearer token is used as receipt, or receipt is sent to account/confirmation routes
cases.then: Uniform unavailable status or unauthorized result; no inventory/account data or destructive authority is granted
cases.evidence_required: Actual API credential audience, enumeration and rate-limit matrix

cases.name: Expired receipt cannot retain its account link indefinitely
cases.given: All work and approved receipt-retention conditions have elapsed
cases.when: Receipt cleanup executes
cases.then: Digest/status/temporary owner mapping are removed as approved; old credential gives same result as unknown; independently required retirement marker follows its separate policy
cases.evidence_required: Time-controlled purge queries and post-purge API assertions

cases.name: Sensitive fields never enter logs or erasure metadata
cases.given: Synthetic distinctive profile, finance, token, proof, recovery and provider markers exist
cases.when: Preview, confirm, worker failures, status, telemetry and backup failure paths run
cases.then: No sensitive marker or raw receipt credential in logs/audit/error/receipt; only documented minimal fields persist
cases.evidence_required: Captured sink scanning plus schema/response inspection with synthetic fixtures

cases.name: Background, lock and process loss cannot silently confirm
cases.given: Web/Android/iOS is previewing or confirming
cases.when: Client backgrounds, locks or terminates before/after commit and delayed responses arrive
cases.then: No automatic confirmation/reopen; local secrets clear according to lifecycle; saved receipt resolves committed outcome and UI does not confuse closure with completion
cases.evidence_required: Deterministic client state tests plus actual native/browser lifecycle coverage

cases.name: Lost root or receipt has no email/support bypass
cases.given: No current root proof is possible or receipt credential is lost after closure
cases.when: User supplies email, finance details, ordinary-device access or a support claim
cases.then: Explain the actual limits; do not grant root erasure/status authority through an undocumented recovery route
cases.evidence_required: Authorization negatives and reviewed localized support/UI copy

cases.name: Rollback and completion reporting remain truthful
cases.given: Closure/purge is partly complete with one failed adapter or expired backup still present
cases.when: Application deployment rolls back or operator retries completion
cases.then: Closed account stays closed, durable work resumes, evidence dimensions remain pending/blocked/retained, and no deleted=true or complete_in_scope is fabricated
cases.evidence_required: Deployment rollback drill and state-transition/receipt tests
